datasets.notes: ASTAP does not stamp a meaningful DisplayVersion/FileVersion, and astap.exe's file timestamps reflect the vendor's original build date, NOT the install date (confirmed via live testing: LastWriteTimeUtc showed 2026-09-03 even though it was reinstalled on 2026-09-09). Freshness is tracked via the registry Uninstall key's InstallDate field instead (set by Inno Setup, reliably reflects actual install date). KNOWN ISSUE: an orphaned duplicate ASTAP uninstall registry key from a 2024-03-29 install still exists alongside the current one (both named 'ASTAP') - detection sorts by InstallDate descending to always prefer the newest, but the stale key + its unins000.exe should be cleaned up manually.

ninaPlugins.note: Version is NOT reliable from the plugin DLL FileVersion (NINA doesn't stamp it meaningfully). It IS reliably logged by NINA's PluginLoader on every successful load, e.g. 'Successfully loaded plugin <Name> version <Version> by <Author>'. Enforcement here means: verify the pinned version was the one most recently logged as loaded. There is NO official API/CLI to install or update NINA plugins; NINA's Plugin Manager (GUI) is the only sanctioned path. This tool CAN download+checksum-verify the plugin archive from the community manifest repo and drop it into pluginFolderPath (mirroring what NINA does internally), but this is unofficial - NINA must be closed during the copy and restarted afterward to pick it up.
